english.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken expression for putting a mark on something or marking a place for reference.

examples.english: I’ll mark this spot on the map so I can find it again next time.
examples.traditional: 我喺地圖上呢個位做記號，方便下次搵返。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 dei6 tou4 soeng6 ni1 go3 wai2 zou6 gei3 hou6 fong1 bin6 haa6 ci3 wan2 faan1
